# Correction of one hour with an ADJUSTMENT journal

> `adjust` fixes one already-billed campaign hour by marking its billing run as reconciled and posting an `ADJUSTMENT` ledger journal worth the click difference times the price per click.

_Part of [Daily reconciliation against the raw click log](daily-reconciliation.md)_

`adjust` is a private method in [`AdBillingJobs`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md). The daily job [`reconcileDay`](daily-reconciliation.md) calls it when a billed hour has not been reconciled yet and its billed click count differs from the exact count in the raw click log. It gets the campaign, the hour, the clicks that were billed and the exact clicks. Everything runs in one database transaction. First it reads the shop and the price per click from `AdCampaign`. It then works out the money difference: `(exactClicks - billedClicks) * cpcCents`. A positive number means the shop was under-billed. A negative number means the shop gets a refund. See [Signed money difference between exact and billed clicks](adjustment-amount.md). Next it updates the `AdBillingRun` row for that campaign and hour. It sets the reconciled click count and stores the new journal id, but only if the reconciled click count is still empty. This is the once-only guard, see Update that only matches an unreconciled billing run. If no row was updated, or the difference is 0, it stops. Otherwise it posts an `ADJUSTMENT` journal through the ledger and logs the change. See [ADJUSTMENT ledger journal moving money between shop and platform fees](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md).

**Look at:** [ad-billing.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/ad-billing.jobs.ts)

## Pieces

- [Signed money difference between exact and billed clicks](adjustment-amount.md): The difference is exact clicks minus billed clicks, times the campaign's price per click in cents; positive means under-billed, negative means refund.
- Update that only matches an unreconciled billing run: The `UPDATE` on `AdBillingRun` requires `reconciledClicks IS NULL`, so an hour is adjusted at most once, and it records the journal id in `adjustmentJournalId`.
- [ADJUSTMENT ledger journal moving money between shop and platform fees](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md): Posts two lines: the shop account gets minus the difference and the `PLATFORM_FEES` account gets plus the difference, so the journal sums to zero.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `AdCampaign` | Read for the shop id and the price per click in cents (`cpcCents`). |
| database | `AdBillingRun` | Updated with the exact click count (`reconciledClicks`) and the adjustment journal id (`adjustmentJournalId`) for the campaign and hour. |
| other | `Ledger journal of kind ADJUSTMENT` | Posted via `LedgerService.post` in the same transaction, with a new [`uuidv7`](../../../../packages/backend/scripts/load-tests/lib/utils.js#L14) journal id. |

## Also relies on

- [Recording money in the ledger](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md) (domain/payments): Posts the balanced `ADJUSTMENT` journal through [`LedgerService`](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md).

## Watch out

- The `AdBillingRun` row is marked reconciled even when the difference is 0, so that hour is never checked again.
- A negative difference is a refund to the shop, and the shop line gets the opposite sign of the difference.
- Unlike `charge`, `adjust` does not apply the daily budget cap, so an under-billing can push the day's total above the budget.
- `adjust` assumes the campaign exists; it reads the first row without checking for a missing one.
